verdict.rationale: Close can be driven non-interactively through its REST API. API keys are documented as 'best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations', and the API supports programmatic bulk actions, sequences and email/SMS, backed by a published OpenAPI spec and a Python client. However, there is no first-party CLI, headless runner or CI-specific documentation, so CI automation means building against the raw API. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/pipeline usage guidance, first-party (not community) SDKs, hands-on corroboration of scripted/CI use.
